<?php

namespace Italamp\OnPage\Jobs;

use OnPage\Api;
use OnPage\Thing;
use OnPage\Resource;
use App\Models\ProductFinish;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use App\Models\ProductComponent;
use App\Models\ProductFinishLang;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Bus\Dispatchable;

/**
 * Salva le finiture remote.
 * I prodotti padre devono già essere presenti in db.
 */
class SyncFinishes implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable;
    use InteractsWithQueue;
    use Queueable;
    use SerializesModels;
    use OnPageMiddleware;

    /**
     * The number of times the job may be attempted.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    public $tries = 3;

    /**
     * Timeout
     */
    public $timeout = 3600;


    /**
     * @var Resource
     */
    protected $resource;


    /**
     * Create a new command instance.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->queue = 'onpage_sync';
    }

    /**
     * Execute the console command.
     * Per info sulla modalità di salvataggio e sulla struttura dei dati,
     * v. .DOCS/prodotti.md
     *
     * @return int
     */
    public function handle(\OnPage\Schema $api)
    {
        /**
         * Imposto voci come temporanee
         */
        ProductFinish::withTrashed()->update(['import_status' => 0]);

        // get remote resource for later use
        $remoteName = 'finiture';
        $this->resource = $api->resource($remoteName);

        // base remote query
        $query = $api->query('finiture')->with('componenti');

        // get remote entitities and loop through them
        $k = 0;
        $query->cursor(function ($remoteItem) use (& $k) {
            $k++;
            $this->saveFinish($remoteItem);
        }, 10);


        /**
         * Ripristino / cancellazione voci
         */
        ProductFinish::withTrashed()->where('import_status', 0)->delete();
        ProductFinish::withTrashed()->where('import_status', 1)->restore();

        return 1;
    }


    /**
     * Salva le finiture per un componente
     */
    protected function saveFinish(Thing $remoteFinish)
    {
        /**
         * Salvo finitura locale (main e lingua)
         */
        $localItem = ProductFinish::withTrashed()->firstOrNew([
            'onpage_id' => $remoteFinish->id
        ]);

        $localItem->onpage_resource = 'finiture';
        $localItem->onpage_raw = $localItem->collectFields($remoteFinish, $this->resource);
        $localItem->import_status = 1;
        $localItem->save();

        foreach (config('marvin.locales') as $localeId =>  $localeInfo) {
            $localItemLang = ProductFinishLang::firstOrNew([
                'item_id' => $localItem->id,
                'lang' => $localeId,
            ]);

            $localItemLang->title = $remoteFinish->val('nome', $localeInfo[0]);

            $localItemLang->save();
        }


        /**
         * Salvo immagine
         */
        $localItem->onPageSyncFiles([
            'image'
        ], config('marvin.functions.finish'));



        /**
         * Relaziono finitura locale con componente locale
         */
        $rel = [];
        foreach ($remoteFinish->rel('componenti')->all() as $remoteComponent) {
            // search for local corresponding item
            $localComponent = ProductComponent::withTrashed()->where('onpage_id', $remoteComponent->id)->first();
            if ($localComponent) {
                $rel[] = $localComponent->id;
            }
        }

        $localItem->components()->sync($rel);
    }
}

/**
 * Sync remote certifications to local ones.
 */
class SyncCertifications implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable;
    use InteractsWithQueue;
    use Queueable;
    use SerializesModels;
    use OnPageMiddleware;

    /**
     * The number of times the job may be attempted.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    public $tries = 3;

    /**
     * Timeout
     */
    public $timeout = 3600;


    /**
     * Create a new command instance.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->queue = 'onpage_sync';
    }

    /**
     * Execute the console command.
     * Per info sulla modalità di salvataggio e sulla struttura dei dati,
     * v. .DOCS/prodotti.md
     *
     * @return int
     */
    public function handle(\OnPage\Schema $api)
    {
        /**
         * Imposto voci come temporanee
         */
        Certification::withTrashed()->update(['import_status' => 0]);

        $remoteName = 'certificazioni';

        // get remote resource for later use
        $resource = $api->resource($remoteName);

        // callback to customize query
        $query = $api->query($remoteName)->with('prodotti');

        // get all remote entitities
        $remoteCollection = $query->all();

        $remoteCollection->each(function ($remoteItem, $i) use ($resource) {
            // search for local corresponding item and create one if none was found
            $localItem = Certification::withTrashed()->byOnPage($resource->name, $remoteItem->id)->firstOrNew();
            if ($localItem->onpage_sync == 'N') {
                return;
            }

            $localItem->import_status = 1;
            $localItem->save();

            // let model map its data
            $localItem->onPageUpdateFromRemote($remoteItem, $resource);
            $localItem->onPageSyncFiles([
                'image'
            ], config('marvin.functions.certification'), true);

            $saved[] = $remoteItem;

            /**
             * Salvo relazione con prodotti.
             * Recupero tutti i prodotti remoti che hanno questa certificazione
             */
            $rel = [];
            foreach ($remoteItem->rel('prodotti') as $remoteProduct) {
                $localProduct = Product::where('onpage_id', $remoteProduct->id)->first();
                if (!$localProduct) {
                    continue;
                }
                $rel[] = $localProduct->id;
            }
            $localItem->products()->sync($rel);
        });


        /**
         * Ripristino / cancellazione voci
         */
        Certification::withTrashed()->where('import_status', 0)->delete();
        Certification::withTrashed()->where('import_status', 1)->restore();

        return 1;
    }
}

 */
class SyncSubcategories implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable;
    use InteractsWithQueue;
    use Queueable;
    use SerializesModels;
    use OnPageMiddleware;

    /**
     * The number of times the job may be attempted.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    public $tries = 3;

    /**
     * Timeout
     */
    public $timeout = 3600;


    /**
     * Create a new command instance.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->queue = 'onpage_sync';
    }

    /**
     * Execute the console command.
     *
     * @return int
     */
    public function handle(\OnPage\Schema $api)
    {

        /**
         * Imposto voci come temporanee
         */
        Prodcat::subcategories()->withTrashed()->update(['import_status' => 0]);

        // get remote resource for later use
        $remoteName = 'sottocategorie';
        $resource = $api->resource($remoteName);

        // base remote query
        $query = $api->query($remoteName)->with('categorie');

        // get remote entitities
        $remoteCollection = $query->all();

        $remoteCollection->each(function ($remoteItem) use ($resource) {

            $remoteParent = $remoteItem->rel('categorie')->first();
            if (!$remoteParent) {
                return;
            }

            // find local parent, stop if none found
            $localParentItem = Prodcat::byOnPage('categorie', $remoteParent->id)->first();

            if (!$localParentItem) {
                return;
            }


            // search for local corresponding item and create one if none was found
            $localItem = Prodcat::byOnPage($resource->name, $remoteItem->id)->firstOrNew();

            if ($localItem->onpage_sync == 'N') {
                return;
            }

            // add extra data
            if (!$localItem->parent_id) {
                $localItem->parent_id = $localParentItem->id;
            }

            // confermo voce
            $localItem->import_status = 1;
            $localItem->save();

            // let model map its data
            $localItem->onPageUpdateFromRemote($remoteItem, $resource);

            $saved[] = $remoteItem->id;
        });


        // pulisco voci che non sono stati confermate
        Prodcat::subcategories()->withTrashed()->where('import_status', 0)->delete();
        Prodcat::subcategories()->withTrashed()->where('import_status', 1)->restore();


        return 1;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Kaleido\KaleidoComposition;
use App\Models\Kaleido\KaleidoElement;
use App\Models\Kaleido\KaleidoSuggestion;
use App\Models\Page;
use App\Services\Breadcrumbs;
use AtrioTeam\Marvin\App\Localization\LangManager;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class KaleidoController extends Controller
{
    public function index(LangManager $LangManager)
    {
        $data['page'] = Page::listByLang($LangManager->lgId())->where('code', 'kaleido_index')->first();
        $data['suggestions'] = KaleidoSuggestion::listByLang($LangManager->lgId())->get();
        return view('products.kaleido.index', $data);
    }


    /**
     * Elements
     */
    public function elements(LangManager $LangManager): View
    {
        $data['page'] = Page::listByLang($LangManager->lgId())->where('code', 'kaleido_elements')->first();
        $data['elements'] = KaleidoElement::listByLang($LangManager->lgId())->get();

        return view('products.kaleido.elements', $data);
    }


    /**
     * Element Detail
     *
     * @param Request $request
     * @param LangManager $LangManager
     * @param string $itemUrl
     **/
    public function elementDetail(Request $request, LangManager $LangManager, string $itemUrl): View
    {
        $data['item'] = KaleidoElement::byUrl($itemUrl, $LangManager->lgId())->firstOrFail();
        $data['downloads'] = $data['item']->downloads()->get();
        // Suggerimenti che contengono Composizioni che contengono Finiture che contengono Elementi che sono il mio elemento, nell'universo conosciuto non oltre il quasar QSO J0313−1806.
        $data['suggestions'] = KaleidoSuggestion::whereHas('compositions', function ($query) use ($data) {
            $query->whereHas('finishes', function ($query) use ($data) {
                $query->whereHas('element', function ($query) use ($data) {
                    $query->where('parent_id', $data['item']->id);
                });
            });
        })
        ->where('is_kaleido', 0)
        ->get();

        $data['finishes'] = $data['item']->finishes()
            ->listByLang($LangManager->lgId())
            ->get();

        // elemento per alternates (v. ViewServiceProvider)
        $data['alternateItemSource'] = $data['item'];

        $lights = $data['item']->lights()->with('category')->listByLang($LangManager->lgId())->get();

        // group lights by category
        $data['lightsByCategory'] = [];
        foreach ($lights as $light) {
            $categoryId = $light->category ? $light->category->id : 0;
            if (!isset($data['lightsByCategory'][$categoryId])) {
                $data['lightsByCategory'][$categoryId] = [
                    'title' => $light->category->current_lang->title,
                    'position' => $light->category->position,
                    'lights' => [],
                ];
            }
            $data['lightsByCategory'][$categoryId]['lights'][] = $light;
        }

        // sort categories by position
        uasort($data['lightsByCategory'], function ($a, $b) {
            return $a['position'] <=> $b['position'];
        });

        // breadcrumb
        app(Breadcrumbs::class)->push((string) $data['item']->current_lang->title);

        return view('products.kaleido.elementDetail', $data);
    }


    /**
     * Suggestions
     */
    public function suggestions(LangManager $LangManager): View
    {
        $data['page'] = Page::listByLang($LangManager->lgId())->where('code', 'kaleido_suggestions')->first();
        $data['items'] = KaleidoSuggestion::listByLang($LangManager->lgId())->get();
        return view('products.kaleido.suggestions', $data);
    }


    /**
     * Compositions
     *
     * @param LangManager $LangManager
     */
    public function compositions(LangManager $LangManager): View
    {
        $data['page'] = Page::listByLang($LangManager->lgId())->where('code', 'kaleido_compositions')->first();
        // Elementi che contengono Finiture che contengono Composizioni che NON SONO "kaleido" che il mio server comprò.
        $data['elements'] = KaleidoElement::listByLang($LangManager->lgId())
            ->withWhereHas('finishes', function ($query) use ($LangManager) {
                $query->withWhereHas('compositions', function ($query) use ($LangManager) {
                    $query->where('is_kaleido', 0)->listByLang($LangManager->lgId());
                });
            })
            ->get()
        ;
        // Carico le composizioni per ogni elemento, per gestire l'ordinamento delle composizioni
        foreach ($data['elements'] as $element) {
            $compositions = [];
            foreach ($element->finishes as $finish) {
                foreach ($finish->compositions as $composition) {
                    $compositions[] = $composition;
                }
            }
            $element->compositions = collect($compositions)->sortBy('position');
        }

        // Elementi che contengono Finiture che contengono Composizioni che SONO "kaleido" che il mio server comprò.
        $data['elementsKaleido'] = KaleidoElement::listByLang($LangManager->lgId())
            ->withWhereHas('finishes', function ($query) {
                $query->withWhereHas('compositions', function ($query) {
                    $query->where('is_kaleido', 1);
                });
            })
            ->get()
        ;
        // Carico le composizioni per ogni elemento, per gestire l'ordinamento delle composizioni
        foreach ($data['elementsKaleido'] as $element) {
            $compositions = [];
            foreach ($element->finishes as $finish) {
                foreach ($finish->compositions as $composition) {
                    $compositions[] = $composition;
                }
            }
            $element->compositions = collect($compositions)->sortBy('position');
        }

        $data['items'] = KaleidoComposition::listByLang($LangManager->lgId())->orderBy('position', 'ASC')->get();
        return view('products.kaleido.compositions', $data);
    }


    /**
     * Composition Detail
     *
     * @param Request $request
     * @param LangManager $LangManager
     * @param string $itemUrl
     **/
    public function compositionDetail(Request $request, LangManager $LangManager, string $itemUrl): View
    {
        $data['item'] = KaleidoComposition::byUrl($itemUrl, $LangManager->lgId())->firstOrFail();
        $data['finishes'] = $data['item']->finishes()
                                ->listByLang($LangManager->lgId())
                                ->with('element', function ($query) use ($LangManager) {
                                    $query->listByLang($LangManager->lgId());
                                })
                                ->get();

        $data['element'] = null;
        if (!$data['item']->is_kaleido) {
            $data['element'] = $data['finishes'][0]->element()->first();
        }
        $data['downloads'] = $data['item']->downloads()->get();
        $data['galleries'] = $data['item']
            ->galleries()
            ->where('item_type', 'gallery')
            ->with('langs', function ($query) use ($LangManager) {
                $query->where('lang', $LangManager->lgId());
            })
            ->get();

        // Altre composizioni dello stesso elemento
        $data['otherCompositions'] = null;
        if ($data['element']) {
            $data['otherCompositions'] = KaleidoComposition::listByLang($LangManager->lgId())
                ->where([
                    ['is_kaleido', 0],
                    ['id', '!=', $data['item']->id], // Escludo la composizione corrente
                ])
                ->withWhereHas('finishes', function ($query) use ($data) {
                    $query->where('parent_id', $data['element']->id);
                })
                ->get();
        }

        $data['widgets'] = $data['item']->widgets()->listByLang($LangManager->lgId())->get();

        // elemento per alternates (v. ViewServiceProvider)
        $data['alternateItemSource'] = $data['item'];


        // breadcrumb
        app(Breadcrumbs::class)->push((string) $data['item']->current_lang->title);

        return view('products.kaleido.compositionDetail', $data);
    }
}
